name: Agentic Agile
purpose: Coordinate scale-adaptive planning, UX spine alignment, verification-gap review, docs drift checks, and direct implementation handoffs for agentic software delivery.
guardrails: requirements must be auditable before implementation
design components must map to experience flows
source or framework changes require matching documentation review
planning packets are research and scoping evidence, not implementation proof
quality: requirement omission rate tracked before completion
claim ceiling preserved in every receipt
human approval required for high-risk transitions
